label: Brow padding

range.endpoint_anchor: supraorbital tissue depth: 0 = 6.0 mm; -100..+100 = 3..9 mm total [D]; lean modern -25 (~4.5 mm), full modern +35 (~7.5 mm) [D from S range]

region.mask_rule: soft tissue over the frontal bone band above the orbits; tissue layer of the layered head stack

semantics: Total soft-tissue depth over the brow band (skin + subcutaneous + ROOF fat), redistributing into an upper-lid hood at high values with low BrowPosition. 0 = 6.0 mm [D, centred on the sourced forensic range]. Hard rule: padding softens, it never creates or erases a sulcus, and never fakes a torus on a gracile head (brow-study sections 4/5.6). A tissue-layer slider in the layered head stack (blueprint section 7.4).
